_comment: NeMo Data Designer recipe template for STRUCTURED DOCUMENT extraction (invoices, contracts, forms, specs). IMPORTANT: system_prompt is an expression passthrough from the seed parquet (composed by materialize_seed.py from root persona + topic hierarchy), NOT LLM-generated. All records in a topic share the same system prompt for consistent GRPO training. Pattern: rag-retrieval → topic_context expression → subcategory sampler → llm-structured (drop:true) → expression (drop:true) → two-stage question generation → llm-text outputs. Copy, replace <PLACEHOLDERS>, adapt output_format schema and section values to your document type.

columns.name: extracted_fields

title.description: Title or heading of this section

key_values.description: Key facts, values, or requirements from this section

summary.description: One-sentence summary of the section's main point

columns.name: composed_context
raw_question
user_message
reference_answer
judge_answerable

scores.name: answerable
scores.description: Whether the question can be answered from the provided content alone.

options.0: Content does not contain sufficient information to answer the question.
options.1: Content contains sufficient information to answer the question.

columns.name: judge_groundedness

scores.name: groundedness
scores.description: Whether every claim in the answer is directly supported by the content.

options.0: Not grounded — answer contains claims absent from or contradicted by content.
options.0.5: Partially grounded — most claims supported but some require outside knowledge.
options.1: Fully grounded — every claim is directly supported by content.

columns.name: judge_specificity

scores.name: specificity
scores.description: Whether the question contains domain-specific terms grounded in the content.

options.0: Generic — question uses no domain-specific terms found in the content.
options.1: Specific — question uses domain terminology present in the content.
